groups.title: Identity inputs
groups.note: The four lines a project sets on `:root`: the hue for light and dark, and the two font stacks. Every other token follows from them.
groups.comment:
Identity layer: a project swaps these four lines. --color-project is the light-theme hue;
--color-project-dark is the dark-theme hue, also used on dark plates in both themes.

roles.color-project-dark: The `$` prompt on the command plate
roles.font-ui: Prose, h3 and below, application section headings, labels, and controls
roles.font-mono: Identity, documentation and product page titles and section headings, navigation rails, metadata, captions, code, identifiers, and keys

tokens.font-ui: "IBM Plex Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
tokens.font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.title: Surfaces, text, and lines
groups.note: Neutral paper in light and graphite in dark. Contrast, not colour, separates regions.
groups.comment: Core roles: only the identity lines above feed them. Neutral paper and graphite surfaces.

notes.color-well: The well: segmented and switch tracks, pressed buttons, selected radio cards, and disabled fields.
notes.color-field-bg:
Fields (input, select, textarea, search): a white fill with a faint edge in light, the sunk well in dark.
Dark fields stay sunk in the well. It sits within about 1.01:1 of the canvas, so the edge carries the shape.
notes.color-nav-current: Selected rows lift and take a faint accent tint, so the selection reads on near-white panels too.
notes.color-nav-current-text:
Text on the current nav row, selected tab, and selected list row: the first of --color-accent, --color-text, black, and white
that reaches 4.5:1 over --color-nav-current, on the page and on a surface.
notes.color-segmented-current-text:
The selected segmented label: the first of --color-accent, --color-text, black, and white that reaches
4.5:1 on the thumb. An icon-only option needs 3:1.

roles.color-surface-muted: Neutral badges, slider and progress tracks, and radio card hover
roles.color-well: The well: segmented and switch tracks, pressed buttons, selected radio cards, and disabled fields
roles.color-field-bg: Field fill: `--color-surface-raised` in light, the sunk `--color-well` well in dark. It stays the same on focus
roles.color-field-edge: Field border at rest: `--color-border-subtle` in both themes. Focus turns it `--color-accent`
roles.shadow-field: Fields at rest: none in light, where the white fill and edge carry the shape; `--shadow-sink` in dark. Disabled fields drop it
roles.color-nav-current: Current navigation row and selected tab, with `--shadow-nav-current`
roles.color-nav-current-text: Text on the current row and selected tab: the first of `--color-accent`, `--color-text`, black, and white that reaches 4.5:1 on the tinted fill
roles.color-segmented-current-text: The selected segmented label: the first of `--color-accent`, `--color-text`, black, and white that reaches 4.5:1 on the thumb (3:1 for an icon)
roles.color-row-hover: Hover on navigation rows, tabs, ghost buttons, and listbox options
roles.color-row-selected: Checked option in a select picker
roles.color-border: Unchecked checkbox and radio edges; the off switch track mixes it into `--color-well`

groups.title: Accent and links
groups.note: The hue fills the one primary action and marks selection and focus. Links keep their own colour.
groups.comment: The hue fills primary actions and marks selection; links keep --color-link.

notes.color-focus:
One focus ring for every role: the accent, at 3:1 or more on --color-bg, --color-surface, and --color-surface-raised
in both themes. Fields mark focus with their own accent edge instead; see components.md.

roles.color-accent: Primary action fill, marks, current items, checked controls; 4.5:1 where it colors text
roles.color-accent-hover: No core component reads it; it mirrors `--color-accent-hover` in `@filipgutica/ui`
roles.color-focus: The one focus ring on every role but fields: the accent
roles.focus-width: One ring for every role but fields: buttons, quiet actions, links, tabs, and navigation rows. `--color-focus` is the accent, at 3:1 or more on every surface. It has no glow and sits over the control's own raise or sink shadow. Pointer hover never draws focus.
roles.focus-offset: The gap between a control and its ring

groups.title: Status
groups.note: Only for state, always with a text or icon label. Each has a soft surface for alerts and badges.
groups.comment: Status: only for state, never for decoration.

roles.color-success: Success state: icons, and the success alert and badge. Always with a text label
roles.color-warning: Warning state: icons, and the warning alert and badge. Always with a text label
roles.color-error: Errors and destructive actions: invalid field edges, field error text, the danger button label, and error icons
roles.color-info: Information state: icons, and the info alert and badge

groups.title: Terminal plates
groups.note: Derived from the hue: the tinted command plate and the neutral terminal capture of the terminal folio identity. A project without plates leaves them unused.
groups.comment:
Identity layer, derived: terminal folio plates. Commands take the hue; captures stay neutral.
A project without terminal plates leaves these unused.

notes.shadow-nav-current-dark: The terminal capture's header stays dark in both appearances, so its selected tab keeps the dark lift.

roles.color-command-bg: Command plate, tinted with the hue, in both themes
roles.color-command-border: Command plate edge; transparent in light
roles.color-terminal: Terminal capture plate, in both themes
roles.color-terminal-caption: Status-line caption under a terminal capture
roles.color-terminal-caption-text: The status-line caption under a terminal capture
roles.shadow-nav-current-dark: The selected tab's lift in a terminal capture header, which stays dark in both appearances

groups.title: Code
groups.note: Source code wells and their restrained syntax colours.

roles.color-code-text: Plain text in source code wells

groups.title: Type
groups.note: Sizes in rem, so text follows the reader’s font size. The identity inputs name the families.
groups.comment: Type scale. The identity block names the families.

roles.text-xs: Badges, navigation group labels, and code block headers
roles.text-lg: Subheadings (h3 and below) and large controls
roles.text-reading: Paragraphs and article text, with `--leading` and `--measure`
roles.text-display: Product page and tool home title, in mono
roles.weight-regular: Body text, labels, and rows that are not current
roles.text-code: Inline code, source code, and command plates

groups.title: Space
groups.note: A 4px rhythm: small gaps inside a group, larger gaps between groups.
groups.comment: Space: a 4px rhythm (0.25rem at the default 16px root).

roles.space-1: The smallest rhythm step: an icon and its label, and inner insets
roles.space-2: Gaps inside a group, such as between controls
roles.space-3: Gaps between related rows and fields
roles.space-5: A rhythm step between group and section gaps
roles.space-16: Product section separation at tablet width
roles.space-20: A large rhythm step for page regions

groups.title: Size
groups.note: Control heights, the reading measure, and page widths.

roles.control-sm: Small control height: compact buttons and inline actions
roles.control-md: Default control height on fine pointers

groups.title: Shape
groups.note: One radius per role, from inline code to floating panels.

roles.radius-inline: Places and picked rows: navigation rows, tabs, list rows, breadcrumb links, checkboxes, and keyboard keys
roles.radius-control: Pills that act or set a value: buttons, quiet actions, segmented controls, and their thumbs
roles.radius-panel: Containers: wells, plates, panels, radio cards, alerts, and floating layers
roles.radius-field: Typed fields and controls whose label wraps: inputs, selects, textareas, toggle cards, and pager links
roles.radius-pill: Small state marks: status badges, switch tracks, slider and progress tracks, and score pips

groups.title: Elevation
groups.note: One shadow per depth tier. Pages write no shadow of their own.
groups.comment:
Elevation: DESIGN.md#depth assigns each tier. Idle controls and surfaces take no outer light
highlight and no blur wider than 2px.

notes.shadow-field-focus: A focused field's inset line inside its accent or danger edge. It takes each theme's accent and danger.

roles.shadow-raise: Idle controls: buttons, unselected radio cards, switch knobs, and segmented thumbs
roles.shadow-surface: Containers: panels, cards, source code, command plates, and terminal captures
roles.shadow-sink: Wells: tracks, pressed buttons, selected radio cards, and dark fields
roles.shadow-nav-current: The lift under the current navigation row and the selected tab
roles.shadow-field-focus: A focused field's 2px inset line: the accent at 18%, inside its `--color-accent` edge
roles.shadow-field-focus-invalid: A focused invalid field's inset line: `--color-error` at 18%, inside its `--color-error` edge

groups.title: Motion
groups.note: Short durations for hover and press, a longer one for menus and panels.

roles.duration: Menus, panels, and the switch knob
roles.ease-out: Animate opacity or transform only where it explains a state change

groups.title: Library only
groups.note: @filipgutica/ui variables with no design-language token. `tokens.css` leaves them out.
groups.comment: Library only: @filipgutica/ui variables with no design-language token. tokens.css leaves them out.

roles.color-shadow: Shadow colour for @filipgutica/ui components that draw their own shadow
roles.shadow-control: Outer shadow on @filipgutica/ui controls: none, as idle controls take no lift
